claim: A fresh install with an empty credential store, empty settings, and no environment keys connects AI Horde automatically and anonymously; no secret is ever written or requested for it.

layers.evidence: apps/desktop/src/main.ts:2477 registers the ai-horde adapter unconditionally (registerProviderAdapter → createProviderAdapterFromDefinition, no credential lookup) and immediately sets the FreeCloud connection credentialSource ANONYMOUS_DIRECT / supplyClass COMMUNITY_ANONYMOUS_FREE, then schedules live discovery + qualification. Identical in shape to the R64 kilo block at main.ts:2460.

apps/desktop/src/provider-connections.ts:338 — credentialSourceOf('ai-horde') returns ANONYMOUS_DIRECT when the adapter is registered; it never consults the secret store. FreeCapacitySection renders the honest global-community-pool copy on an empty connections list (free-capacity-settings.test.tsx, 4/4 pass).

apps/desktop/test/ai-horde-fresh-user.test.ts — 2/2 pass: ProviderConnections constructed over a fresh host (empty secrets map, empty settings, empty env) resolves ANONYMOUS_DIRECT, publishAll() lands connected=true with COMMUNITY_ANONYMOUS_FREE, secrets.size stays 0, and cerebras stays credentialSource NONE on the same store.

R65-DOMAIN-B-LIVE.json — the production-shaped run served real AI Horde inference end to end through the adapter using only the documented anonymous key 0000000000 (never stored, never user-supplied). R65-HORDE-QUALIFICATION-google_gemma-4-31b.json records the live 8-Bit qualification on the same anonymous access.
